about.title: About Me
about.bio:
My background began in electronics, repairing and designing circuits. After years as a technician I realized I needed to learn to code, and what started as a tool became a passion. Today, combining electronics and software is not just a technical requirement — it's where I build complete solutions.

I'm currently pursuing a degree in Software Development at Brigham Young University – Idaho while shipping digital products end to end. I'm not limited to IoT: I'm a software developer who builds web applications, SaaS platforms, and connected systems independently.
